title.zh: 修正的 BONK 有界根搜索

summary: Compose complete BONK cases and ordered root searches with explicit verified-root and terminal-state diagnostics.

identity.direction: inverse: angular frequency to candidate wavevector
identity.definition: Fixed bounded dimensionless real/imaginary search at every angular frequency; root_valid requires independent determinant and normwise Maxwell null residual gates.
identity.model: static isotropic Maxwellian plasma or its declared numerical approximation
identity.geometry: uniform background B along z; wavevector (kx,0,kz)
identity.coordinates: Cartesian SI; exp(i k·x−i ωt); signed gyrofrequency and radius
identity.boundary: homogeneous linear response; explicit resonances and analytic removable limits
assumptions: Listed-species linear response; electron-only case2 does not establish global charge neutrality or a self-consistent background equilibrium.

inputs.name: omegas
inputs.description: Angular frequency axis; None selects the source frequency ladder.
inputs.constraints: Finite real nonzero elements; input order retained.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: nf[m^-1], ordered xx[rad/s], root_valid, dual residuals, raw solver flags, iterations/evaluations, all attempts and complete source material state.
outputs.units: mixed SI and dimensionless as described
outputs.constraints: State and terminal diagnostics retain scientific meaning; no caller state mutation.

preconditions: Pinned Linux amd64 GNU Octave7.3.0 runtime; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
NumPy2.5.3 and SciPy1.18.1 Python3.12 scientific development runtime.
supported: Three complete cases and source default77-frequency axis; arbitrary valid finite supplied axes.
Original solver tolerances; explicit bounded attempts and root verification.
excluded: No branch tracking, complete physical-mode enumeration or unconditional convergence.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for unknown controls, nonfinite/incoherent physical inputs, genuine poles or unrepresentable scientific response.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: RuntimeError for unsupported/missing native runtime or abnormal native exit; subprocess timeout is explicit.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Bounded scientific precision/search failures are explicit. BONK returns every attempt and an unverified row when no verified root is found; a raw solver flag alone is not a scientific root.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Operator errors return no result. A completed BONK axis may contain unverified candidates with root_valid false. No hidden partial output is represented as a complete result.

execution.mode: DAG with declared bounded numerical feedback inside each independent frequency search
execution.ordering: derive case, visit axis in source order, try fixed seeds in order, update local fsolve state, verify D, stop at first verified root, collect terminal fields
branches: five fixed seed attempts, early stop on dual root verification
unsolved rows remain explicit candidates with root_valid false
execution.state_ownership: one subprocess owns globals; per-attempt q, residual, trust-region state and diagnostics; no caller global state or frequency continuation
execution.failure_propagation: invalid inputs/precision errors throw; bounded solver termination retained with candidate verification

feedback.state: q real/imaginary coordinates and fsolve trust region; local candidate/attempt diagnostics
feedback.initialization: per omega fixed seeds0.6,0.6+0.1i,0.6−0.1i,1,2 in q=kx/kn
feedback.update_order: evaluate real/imag determinant using fixed attempt reference, fsolve step, retain raw status, independently verify dimensionless D
feedback.continue_when: fsolve has budget and has not terminated; after an unverified attempt advance to next fixed seed
feedback.stop_when: both normalized determinant and sigma_min(D)/max(1,sigma_max(D))<=1e-8, or all five attempts terminate
feedback.iteration_bound: five attempts per omega; each MaxIter400,MaxFunEvals100; TolFun/TolX1e-16
feedback.nonconvergence: return all attempts and best candidate with root_valid false; no invented root
